title: Me
u18: Family mode: squads and share cards open once your parent says yes. Everything else is on.
rankTop: You're at the top rank. Keep your skills fresh.
multFull: Every learning act earns full XP right now.
multLow: After {after} minutes today, XP is ×{m}. It resets at midnight. Your brain keeps more if you come back tomorrow.
xpRules: XP = base × quality. Quality is your score, at least 0.3. Base: mock 40, practice 20, lesson 15, each due review card 5. After 45 minutes in a day it's ×0.5, after 90 minutes ×0.2.
xpNever: No XP for opening the app, sharing, inviting or joining a squad.
khudLine: Got your licence without an agent? Tell us, in your own words.

badge.title: Badges ({e} of 9)
badge.tap: Tap a badge to see what it needs.
badge.note: Badges are for practice. They aren't a licence or a certificate.

khud_licence.name: Khud Licence
khud_licence.criterion: You say you got your DL without paying an agent, with the month you got it. Self-declared.

pehli_baar_pass.name: Pehli Baar Pass
pehli_baar_pass.criterion: You say you passed the driving test at the first attempt. Self-declared.

nazar_90.name: Nazar 90
nazar_90.criterion: Nazar Score 90 or more over 3 counted mocks on clips you haven't seen.

calibrated.name: Calibrated
calibrated.criterion: Brier score 0.18 or less over 40 answers, and your "certain" answers right about as often as you said.

no_zone_navigator.name: No-Zone Navigator
no_zone_navigator.criterion: Blind Spot 85 or more, twice, at least 2 days apart.

golden_hour_ready.name: Golden Hour Ready
golden_hour_ready.criterion: Golden Hour 80 or more with no critical step missed. Opens after the medical review.

streak.title: Your prep road
streak.fill: Fill the week {w} pothole: do {g} sessions this week ({n} + 2).
streak.freeze: Freeze tokens: {k} (used for you automatically if a week slips)
streak.end: Your streak ends on your DL test day. That's the point.
streak.what: A session is a scored game or 10 due review cards.
